meta_description:
1,692 likes, 26 comments - fitmom.club on October 8, 2026: "🔔Save & share this reel with everyone🔔
Some common exposures to be more mindful of:

* 🚫 BPA/BPS- May disrupt hormones
* 🚫 PFAS- Persist in environment
* 🚫 Phthalates- Can affect hormones
* 🚫 Microplastics- Increase chemical exposure
* 🚫 Non-stick chemicals- Potential health concerns
* 🚫 Synthetic fragrances- May irritate airways
* 🚫 Pesticides- Leave chemical residues
* 🚫 Flame retardants- May affect hormones
* 🚫 VOCs- Pollute indoor air
* 🚫 Heavy metals- Can cause toxicity

You don’t need to fear every chemical or throw everything away. Start with simple swaps:

🥤 Plastic → Glass/stainless steel
🍳 Non-stick → Cast iron/stainless steel
🕯️ Paraffin candles → Beeswax/plant wax
🌸 Synthetic fragrance → Fragrance-free
🍱 Plastic storage → Glass
🔥 Never heat food in plastic
🌬️ Improve ventilation → Cleaner air
📱 Wireless devices → Create distance when practical
🧴 Complex products → Simpler ingredient

#holisticliving #nontoxiclifestyle #healthyswaps #wellness #healthylifestyle

(toxins, chemicals, hormones, plastics, fragrance, pesticides, ventilation, exposure, awareness, home, wellness)".
